entries.title: Psalms 120:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of degrees.>> In my distress I cried unto the LORD, and he heard me.

entries.title: Psalms 120:2
segments: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, [and] from a deceitful tongue.

entries.title: Psalms 120:3
segments: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue? {What shall be given...: or, What shall the deceitful tongue give unto thee? or, what shall is profit thee?} {done: Heb. added}

words.text: unto thee? or what shall be done

entries.title: Psalms 120:4
segments: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper. {Sharp...: or, It is as the sharp arrows of the mighty man, with coals of juniper}

words.text: . {Sharp...: or, It is as the sharp arrows of the mighty man, with coals of juniper}

entries.title: Psalms 120:5
segments: ¶Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, [that] I dwell in the tents of Kedar!

entries.title: Psalms 120:6
segments: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.

entries.title: Psalms 120:7
segments: I [am for] peace: but when I speak, they [are] for war. {for peace: or, a man of peace}

words.text: . {for peace: or, a man of peace}
